_comment: Synthetic but ABI-exact Credited (the NATIVE credit event) logs for the fee escrow. Block 0 = 2026-08-07T00:00:00Z at 1s/block. Recipient shapes: 0xaaaa000000000000000000000000000000000001=durable: above T1 every day, right-censored at both edges; 0xbbbb000000000000000000000000000000000002=completed 10-day spell above T1, days 3..12; 0xcccc000000000000000000000000000000000003=two spells: days 5-7 and days 20-21; 0xdddd000000000000000000000000000000000004=dust: never clears any gate; 0xeeee000000000000000000000000000000000005=T2-scale, days 10..25, completed 16-day spell The address at indexed position 1 is the DEPOSITOR (the V2 Meme Hook), not an asset: the native credit carries its value in msg.value and names no token. A decoder that reads position 1 as the currency produces per-asset buckets headed by this hook address, which is precisely the defect these fixtures now guard against.
